text:
maria (PM): quick async check for the quarter — 1) what shipped, 2) what slipped, 3) owners/next steps. keeping this short, pls ping owners if you need follow-ups

sam (Eng): shipped: runtime v3 autoscale tuning landed last week. verified perf with the billing team — 8% cost down on medium-batch workloads :tada:

leo (Eng Platform): shipped: model routing policy v1 + canary rollout for fallback models. config in `infra/routing/v1.yaml` if you want to review.

tara (Eng): slipped: dedicated cache invalidation API (was planned for last sprint). blocker: perf regression when invalidating hot prefixes under high qps. I'm investigating, will need a small design change. @sam can we pair on repro?

sam (Eng): yep, I can carve out 2hrs tomorrow. suspect KV cache race; saw a couple of stack traces. put me on the PR: #4127

maria (PM): owner for cache API = tara. timeline estimate? if slipping more than 2 weeks we mark as partial.

tara (Eng): estimate ~1 week to fix + 2 days for dogfood and canary. will update PR with a repro and a test plan by EOD.

leo (Eng Platform): dep note: the cache API change touches routing shim, will need a minor bump in the canary (I can take the canary rollout step).

nora (SRE): FYI, the autoscale tuning changed some pod churn patterns — we saw short spikes in pod restarts on one cluster after rollout. nothing critical but keeping eyes on it. alert created: `autoscale-churn-qc`

maria (PM): slipped: public docs for dedicated on-boarding. owner? we need this for customer handoffs next Wed.

leo (Eng Platform): docs owner nominated = me + docs@. I can push a barebones checklist by EOD tomorrow. need content from sales on SSO steps.

maria (PM): next steps list: 1) tara + sam pair debug cache PR (#4127) — owners tara/sam; 2) leo deliver docs checklist + coordinate with sales — owner leo; 3) tara deliver cache fix + tests, target branch cut for canary on 2033457800; 4) nora monitor autoscale alerts and confirm stability before wider rollout.

tara (Eng): ack on items 1 & 3. will post status updates in the PR thread.

sam (Eng): ack; pairing tomorrow 10:30 PT. I'll ping in #eng-platform if I need infra creds.

nora (SRE): I'll mute the noisy alert after we confirm the repro, but will keep the escalation path open. tagging runbook: `SRE/autoscale-runbook.md`

maria (PM): small asks: - if your item is blocked by another team, mention who and ETA - if you need a review, add `review-request` label on PRs - try to keep ship status either "shipped", "on track", or "slipped" for the summary

leo (Eng Platform): review request: I need quick review on the routing policy docs and the canary config — PR #4210. reviewers: @tara @nora

tara (Eng): putting it on my queue now.

sam (Eng): also pinging @security for cache invalidation change, since it touches auth tokens in the shim. Security PR will follow.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for routing v1 at 2033457800 — will run incremental traffic over 30m and auto-rollback on >1% error bump

maria (PM): thanks all. I'll compile a short one-paragraph update for execs after the canary window. if anything slips further, update this thread. :+1:

leo (Eng Platform): quick status update: docs checklist posted (link: https://redwood.docs/dedicated-onboard-checklist) — still need SSO steps from sales.

sam (Eng): final note: CODE REVIEW ping for #4127 and #4210. small chunks please so we can move fast.

maria (PM): end of thread — if you have blockers after pairing, call a 15m sync. otherwise update PRs and I'll roll into the OKR tracker.
